decisions.reason: A coolant pressure booster fits the firm's core coolant management business and drives aftermarket demand from metalworking customers.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge extends the firm's established filtration offer and supports its sustainability positioning, so it is worth keeping.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost complementary component that rounds out the coolant system portfolio and generates recurring sales.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is a staple of the firm's chip conveying range and sits close to the core business.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor fills a standard niche in a modular chip conveyor lineup that machine tool customers expect.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a core, widely used conveyor type that matches the firm's established offer.
